summary: The image contains two bar charts comparing scores for AIME and MATH under different conditions. The first chart shows scores for TTRL, No Code (1.5B), and No Code (7B), with AIME scores ranging from 15.8 to 20.0 and MATH scores from 73.0 to 73.6. The second chart compares No Code (1.5B), No Code (7B), and With Code (1.5B and 7B), with AIME scores ranging from 18.3 to 21.7 and MATH scores from 73.1 to 74.9. The charts illustrate the impact of coding on performance, with 'With Code' conditions generally showing higher scores.
